maddeler.e:
ننعقد (form VII)
# نَنْعَقِدُ (nanʕaqidu) /nan.ʕa.qi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَقَدَ (inʕaqada)
# نَنْعَقِدَ (nanʕaqida) /nan.ʕa.qi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَقَدَ (inʕaqada)
# نَنْعَقِدْ (nanʕaqid) /nan.ʕa.qid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَقَدَ (inʕaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
